candidates.change_summary: Require msg.value to be 0 instead of 1 ether, so callers need not send 1 ether and stored guess/block differ after call.
Do not set guesses[msg.sender].block (delete that assignment), leaving block as 0 after call.
Set the stored block to current block number instead of block.number + 1, changing observed stored block value.
Set the stored guess to keccak256(hash) (changed stored guess value) before storing block number.
Insert clearing of guesses[msg.sender].guess to zero before setting it, changing observable sequence (intermediate storage may differ in some tooling).
